adapted_from.source_text: Create an editorial portrait of an adult wearing a sculptural hooded coat made from folded newsprint. Cover the background with loosely aligned monochrome newspaper sheets. Use a few pale-yellow highlight bars as the only color accent. The face remains uncovered and sharply focused. Distinguish overlapping coat panels with real paper thickness and soft edge shadows. Treat newspaper text as nonessential texture, not factual reporting. No readable real mastheads or logos.
